scenarios.prompt: Analyze this cascade voice turn: EOT 700 ms, TTFT 620 ms, TTFB 240 ms, E2E 1560 ms. Use the installed latency skill and its bundled calculator. Name the skill and show the first fix. Resolve the helper from the skill directory, not this project's working directory.

required.why: Names end of turn as the first fix

forbidden.why: Must not pick the LLM before endpointing

criteria: Runs the packaged helper from its installed directory
Names endpointing as the first fix

examples.pass: voice-latency-budget: EOT 700 ms is the largest stage. First fix: endpointing delay, then TTFT 620 ms.
examples.fail: voice-latency-budget: first fix is the LLM, swap to a faster model. EOT 700 ms is fine.

scenarios.prompt: Our dashboard shows average voice latency 900 ms across all turns, measured from my laptop on office Wi-Fi. Is our latency good? Name the skill you used.

forbidden.why: Must not bless one averaged laptop number

criteria: Asks for p50 and p95 per stage
Asks for measurement on a real phone call

examples.pass: voice-latency-budget: an average hides the turns callers complain about. Report p50 and p95 per stage, measured on a real phone call, with tool turns bucketed apart.
examples.fail: voice-latency-budget: yes, that is good, 900 ms is under the budget.
